LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_FlowerFairy.label: Flower Fairy
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_FlowerFairy.description:
I am one with the flowers in bloom. I move with the wind and dwell by the water.
—Starts with Aura Ward, Stillness, Trickle, Flowing Form and the Qixi Festival traits.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_FlyingFlowerDecree.label: Flying Flower Decree
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_LotusRain.label: Lotus Rain
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_LotusRain.description:
—Learn Flying Flower Decree: Lotus Rain.
Raise a curtain of rain across the enemy's approach. Those who step in are drenched and greatly slowed; flesh collects toxin, mechanoids collect corrosion. Its line is set by your aim, so it falls exactly where they mean to charge.

LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_SeasonalResonance.description: Attune the rhythm of your aura to grant different harmony effects to yourself and your weapons.

LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_SwordDance.unlockLetter.text: Qinghe has learned the sword art: Illusory Reflection.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_SakuraDance.label: Sakura Dance
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_SakuraDance.description:
A sword art of three cuts made while spinning up into the air. Cast in the rain under the open sky, the blade catches a falling thunderbolt.
—Learn the sword art: Sakura Dance.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Zantetsuken_Guren.label: Zantetsuken: Guren
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Zantetsuken_Guren.description:
A sword art Qinghe learned through exchanges with her teacher Neiyu: kick off an enemy, leap high, and drop straight down with the blade held flat, leaving a crimson lotus where she lands.
—Learn the sword art: Zantetsuken: Guren.
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Gaeshi_Gekka.label: Tsubame Gaeshi: Gekka
LanguageData.MX_QH_Node_Gaeshi_Gekka.description:
After the blade falls, it does not return to the sheath, but turns and cuts back.
—Zantetsuken: Guren stuns for 8 seconds; after landing Qinghe turns the edge and scoops back up into low air, sheathes in mid-air, and the click of the sheath strikes every enemy in the lotus once more for heavy damage.
